name: Gaurav Kumar
role: Senior Full Stack & Generative AI Engineer
statement: I build RAG pipelines, AI agents and vector-search systems that have to hold up under production load — and the backend architecture underneath them. Four years across Python, FastAPI, NestJS, Azure OpenAI and AWS, mostly on systems where a wrong answer costs someone money.
shortStatement: Generative AI engineer and full-stack developer. RAG pipelines, AI agents, vector search, and the cloud architecture that keeps them standing up.
principles: Write down the alternatives you rejected. A decision without its discarded options is not reviewable by the next engineer — it is just a fact someone has to live with.
Answer only from the provided scope. Every retrieval system I build refuses before it guesses, because a confident wrong answer is worse than no answer.
Turn ambiguity into a number before provisioning anything. "Must feel like REST" becomes throughput, latency and per-tenant quota, signed off in writing, or it becomes an argument later.
No custom middleware unless required. Every component you add is one more thing that can fail at 3am and one more thing someone has to understand.
